lessons.title: Oblique Shock and Expansion Waves
lessons.summary: Mach waves, the θ–β–M relation, shock reflection, Prandtl–Meyer expansion and isentropic compression, and shock-expansion theory for flat-plate, wedge, and diamond airfoils.
lessons.description: Interactive lesson on oblique shocks, Mach waves, the θ–β–M relation, shock reflection, Prandtl–Meyer expansion and isentropic compression, and shock-expansion theory for flat-plate, wedge and diamond airfoils. MAE 3293, Oklahoma State University.
lessons.image_alt: Diamond airfoil in supersonic flow with oblique shocks, expansion fans and surface pressure arrows

lessons.title: Nozzles, Diffusers, and Wind Tunnels
lessons.summary: Quasi-one-dimensional flow: the area–velocity and area–Mach relations, choked flow, converging-diverging nozzles with normal shocks inside or at the exit, rocket thrust, diffusers, and supersonic wind-tunnel start-up.
lessons.description: Interactive lesson on quasi-one-dimensional compressible flow: the area–velocity and area–Mach relations, choked flow, converging-diverging nozzles with normal shocks inside or at the exit, overexpanded and underexpanded jets, rocket thrust, diffusers, and supersonic wind tunnels. MAE 3293, Oklahoma State University.
